C04: AMD benchmark footnotes describe different tests/comparison systems; no transfer to this matmul.

questions: Which exact source, inputs and bitstream produced this result, and can the app reject a mismatched result?
Who needed this this weekend and what improvement was observed?
What useful part depends on AI and what blocks a persuasive incorrect receipt?

customer.read: Verified frozen hash; saved guide, current scope/handoff/status, simulation summary and earlier research. No other judge outputs read; external numeric sources not independently refetched.
findings: C01-C03: industry verification pain is context; the narrow evidence-assembly task still needs direct observation.
C04-C07: omit borrowed benchmarks, Amazon scale, adjacent market forecasts and salary figures from short pitch.
C08: measure same-task active time including setup/checking; build waiting time is not payroll automatically saved.
C09: bounded simulation result does not establish switching reason or robotics value.
C10: split physical-receipt completion and customer validation into separate IDs next round. Need is still a hypothesis; do not state every engineer has it.
C11: live hardware conflict needs owner decision or organizer clarification.
No target-user observation, concrete offer/price, demonstrated switching reason or specific first-user channel. Existing scripts, IP/HLS, competing tools and services remain alternatives.
questions: Which engineer had this exact problem recently; what happened and what did they use instead?
Why pay rather than improve existing scripts, and what would you charge?
What can I use and verify now, and what useful job does AI perform?
